# Deferred startup image journey

Synthetic, hostname-neutral replay: the document commits with three ordinary
inline images pending and an inline SVG already available. Image responses
take 20 pumps. Records use v10 security-header completeness so normal resource
admission runs without granting authority to legacy image traces.

The second tail response models cancellation of a two-target batch when its
other target is removed or changes source. The restarted tail request still
has a real, independently claimed response. The changed hero is yellow rather
than red, allowing the test to check publication rather than only completion.
